about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A36: Middle Eastern, North African and Mediterranean lunch plates and boards, smorrebrod and tartines.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken and Preserved Lemon Couscous Plate
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken thigh over fluffy couscous with preserved lemon, olives and parsley.

items: 500g boneless chicken thigh, cut into pieces

steps: Toss the chicken with the cumin, turmeric, paprika and a pinch of salt.
Brown the chicken in the oil over medium-high heat, then cook, turning, until golden and cooked through, about 12 minutes.
Pour the hot stock over the couscous in a bowl, cover and leave until all the stock is absorbed, about 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir the preserved lemon, olives and parsley through the couscous and top with the chicken.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C inside with no pink; wash hands and boards after handling it raw.

recipes.title: Kefta Meatball Pita (Moroccan Spiced Lamb in Pita)
recipes.summary: Cumin and coriander lamb meatballs tucked into warm pita with tomato, yoghurt and mint.
steps: Mix the lamb with the onion, spices, parsley and a good pinch of salt, then roll into 18 small meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in the oil over medium heat, turning, until browned all over and cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and warm the pita.
Fill each pita with meatballs, tomato and minty yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C and be cooked until no pink remains.

recipes.title: Lebanese Chicken Shawarma Plate with Garlic Sauce
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken thigh with garlic sauce, pickles, tomato and flatbread, in plate form.
steps: Coat the chicken with the spices, half the garlic, half the lemon juice and the oil, and leave for 20 minutes.
Cook in a hot frying pan in two batches until browned and cooked through, about 6 minutes each.
Stir the yoghurt, tahini, the remaining garlic and lemon juice into a sauce.
Serve the chicken with warm flatbread, tomato, pickles and the garlic sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; keep raw chicken below 5°C while marinating.

recipes.title: Falafel Plate with Tomato Cucumber Salad and Tahini
recipes.summary: Crisp falafel with a chopped tomato and cucumber salad, hummus, pickles and a lemony tahini sauce.
steps: Bake the falafel in a 200°C oven for 8 to 10 minutes until hot and crisp.
Toss the tomato, cucumber, parsley, olive oil and half the lemon juice together.
Whisk the tahini with the remaining lemon juice and 2 tbsp water until pourable.
Plate the falafel with the salad, hummus, pickles and warm pita and spoon the tahini over.

recipes.title: Mujaddara Lunch Plate with Yoghurt and Cucumber
recipes.summary: Lentils and rice topped with deeply browned onions, served with cool yoghurt and cucumber.
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 15 minutes until almost tender, then drain.
Fry the onions in the oil over medium heat, stirring, until deep brown and crisp at the edges, about 25 minutes.
Stir the rice, cumin, a teaspoon of salt and 350ml water into the lentils, cover and cook gently until all the water is absorbed, about 12 minutes.
Fold half the onions through and top with the rest.
Mix the yoghurt, cucumber and mint and serve alongside.

recipes.title: Kofta Kebab Plate with Tahini Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Herby beef and lamb kofta with a tahini yoghurt, tomato and onion salad and warm flatbread.
steps: Mix the mince with the grated onion, parsley, cumin, allspice and a teaspoon of salt and shape into 6 fat sausages.
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat, turning, until browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt and tahini together.
Serve the kofta on flatbread with the tahini yoghurt, tomato and red onion.
notes: Food safety: minced meat must reach 75°C and be cooked until no pink remains.

recipes.title: Mezze Lunch Board with Hummus, Labneh and Warm Pita
recipes.summary: A relaxed board of hummus, labneh, olives, cucumber, tomato and warm pita for a no-cook lunch.
steps: Warm the pita in a dry pan until soft and lightly blistered, about 30 seconds a side.
Spoon the hummus and labneh onto a board and swirl with the back of a spoon.
Drizzle the oil over both and scatter the sumac.
Arrange the olives, cucumber, tomato, feta and walnuts around the dips and serve with the pita.
notes: Contains gluten, milk, sesame and tree nuts.

recipes.title: Greek Meze Plate with Tzatziki, Feta and Roasted Capsicum
recipes.summary: Tzatziki, roasted capsicum, feta, olives and tomato with warm pita for a summer Greek lunch.
steps: Squeeze the water out of the grated cucumber, then mix it with the yoghurt, garlic and oil to make tzatziki.
Warm the pita in a dry pan until soft, about 30 seconds each side.
Arrange the capsicum, feta, olives and tomato on a platter.
Sprinkle the tomato and feta with oregano and serve with the tzatziki and pita.

recipes.title: Spanakopita Triangles Lunch Plate with Tomato and Olives
recipes.summary: Crisp filo triangles filled with spinach and feta, served with tomato, olives and lemon.
steps: Squeeze the spinach very dry, then mix with the feta, ricotta, egg, spring onions and dill.
Cut each filo sheet into 3 strips, brush with butter and put a spoonful of filling at one end.
Fold the corner over to make a triangle and keep folding to the end of the strip, then brush the top with butter.
Bake in a 190°C oven for 22 to 25 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Serve with the tomato, olives and lemon wedges.
notes: Food safety: bake the filling until piping hot, as it contains raw egg when assembled.

recipes.title: Turkish Meze Lunch Plate with Cacik and Sigara Boregi
recipes.summary: Cigar-shaped feta and parsley pastries with garlicky cucumber yoghurt, olives and tomato.
steps: Mash the feta with the parsley and egg.
Cut the filo into long triangles, put a line of filling along the wide end and roll into cigars, sealing the tip with a little water.
Brush with the oil and bake in a 200°C oven for 12 to 15 minutes until crisp and golden.
Stir the yoghurt, cucumber, garlic and mint into cacik.
Serve the boregi with the cacik, olives and tomato.
notes: Food safety: bake until the filling is hot throughout, as it includes raw egg when rolled.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Tuna and White Bean Lunch Board
recipes.summary: Tuna and cannellini beans with olives, tomato and rocket on a board with toasted bread.
steps: Toast the bread under a grill until golden, about 2 minutes a side, then rub with the cut garlic.
Toss the beans with the oil, lemon juice, capers and a pinch of salt.
Arrange the beans, tuna, olives, tomatoes and rocket on a board.
Serve with the garlic toast while it is still warm and crisp.
notes: Food safety: keep opened tinned tuna covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Smorrebrod with Roast Beef and Pickle Remoulade
recipes.summary: Thin roast beef on buttered rye with a quick pickle and caper remoulade and crisp onion.
steps: Stir the mayonnaise, pickles, capers, mustard and horseradish together into a remoulade.
Butter the rye slices right to the edges until each is evenly covered.
Fold the beef over the bread in loose ribbons.
Spoon the remoulade over the beef until the slices are well covered and finish with the crisp onions.
notes: Food safety: cooked sliced beef should stay below 5°C and be eaten within 2 days of opening.
Contains gluten, egg, milk and mustard.

recipes.title: Smorrebrod with Smoked Salmon and Cucumber
recipes.summary: Dark rye with horseradish cream cheese, smoked salmon, cucumber ribbons and dill.
steps: Beat the cream cheese with the horseradish and spread over the rye.
Toss the cucumber ribbons with the lemon juice.
Drape the salmon over the bread until each slice is covered and add the cucumber.
Finish with dill and capers.
notes: Food safety: smoked salmon is ready to eat but should be kept below 5°C and eaten within 2 days of opening; pregnant people are often advised to avoid it.
Contains gluten, fish, milk and egg.

recipes.title: Smorrebrod with Liver Pate and Pickled Beetroot
recipes.summary: Rye topped with smooth liver pate, tangy beetroot and crisp onion, a Danish classic.
steps: Butter the rye slices right to the edges until evenly covered.
Spread the pate over the bread in an even layer.
Lay the beetroot slices over the pate until it is just covered, then add the pickles.
Finish with the fried onions and dill.
notes: Food safety: pate is a high-risk food for pregnancy and should be kept below 5°C; eat within 2 days of opening.

recipes.title: Smorrebrod with Potato, Chives and Radish
recipes.summary: Rye topped with sliced potato, mayo, radish, chives and a soft herb sprinkle, a simple vegetarian smorrebrod.
steps: Boil the potato slices until tender, about 12 minutes, drain and cool.
Butter the rye and spread with the mayonnaise.
Layer the potato over the bread and season with salt.
Top with radish, chives, dill and a squeeze of lemon juice.

recipes.title: Tartine with Ricotta, Peas and Mint
recipes.summary: Crusty toast with whipped lemon ricotta, crushed peas and mint, a fresh spring open sandwich.
steps: Cook the peas in boiling water until tender, about 3 minutes, drain and lightly crush with the oil and mint.
Toast the bread until golden and rub with the cut garlic.
Beat the ricotta with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt until light.
Spread the ricotta on the toast and spoon over the peas until generously covered.

recipes.title: Tartine with Goat Cheese, Honey and Walnuts
recipes.summary: Grilled sourdough topped with creamy goat cheese, honey, thyme and walnuts, with peppery rocket.
steps: Spread the goat cheese on the bread and grill until the cheese is soft and lightly golden, about 4 minutes.
Toss the rocket with the oil and a pinch of salt.
Drizzle the toasts with the honey and scatter with walnuts and thyme.
Serve with the rocket on top.
notes: Contains gluten, milk and tree nuts.

recipes.title: Tartine with Avocado and Soft Egg
recipes.summary: Toasted sourdough with smashed avocado, lemon, chilli and a jammy egg.
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 6 minutes for a jammy yolk, then cool in cold water and peel.
Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with halved eggs and sprinkle with chilli flakes.
notes: Food safety: soft-yolk eggs are not recommended for young children, pregnant people or older adults; use eggs boiled for 8 minutes if unsure.

recipes.title: Tartine with Tuna, Tomato and Olives
recipes.summary: Grilled sourdough with olive oil tuna, ripe tomato, olives and parsley.
steps: Toast the bread until golden and rub with the cut garlic.
Flake the tuna with the oil and lemon juice.
Layer the tomato on the toast until covered and season with salt.
Top with the tuna, olives and parsley.
notes: Food safety: keep opened tinned tuna covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Tartine with Roasted Mushrooms and Thyme
recipes.summary: Garlicky roast mushrooms and thyme piled on toasted sourdough over soft cheese.
steps: Toss the mushrooms with the oil, garlic, thyme and salt on a tray and roast at 220°C until browned and shrunken, about 18 minutes.
Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the toast with cream cheese until covered.
Pile on the mushrooms, drizzle with the balsamic and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.title: Halloumi and Roast Vegetable Pita Plate with Hummus
recipes.summary: Golden halloumi with roast zucchini, capsicum and red onion, served with hummus and warm pita.
steps: Roast the zucchini, capsicum and onion with the oil and salt at 220°C until browned at the edges, about 22 minutes.
Fry the halloumi in a dry pan over medium-high heat until golden on both sides, about 2 minutes a side.
Warm the pita in a dry pan.
Serve the vegetables and halloumi with hummus, pita, lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.title: Harissa Chicken Flatbread with Yoghurt and Herbs
recipes.summary: Harissa-coated chicken on warm flatbread with cucumber, yoghurt and herbs.
steps: Coat the chicken with the harissa and oil.
Cook in a hot frying pan in two batches until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes each.
Warm the flatbreads and spread with the yoghurt.
Top with chicken, cucumber, coriander and lemon juice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C inside with no pink.
